error.title: We could not read where your order is
error.body: The connection or our service did not answer. Nothing is lost: try again.

dead.title: This tracking link no longer works
dead.body: It was withdrawn, or the page ended 60 days after delivery. Ask for a new link: we send it to the address the link went to.

ask.label: Ask for a new link
ask.held: Already asked: look in the mailbox the link went to.
ask.done: We passed it on. If the link was ours, a new one goes to the address it was sent to.
ask.failed: Your request did not reach us. Check the connection and ask again.
ask.onlyOnFile: A new link only ever goes to the address on file, never to one typed here.

now.PACKED: Packed and waiting for the carrier.

problem.DELAYED: The carrier reports a delay or a missed delivery.
problem.RETURNING: The carrier is bringing it back to us.
problem.RETURNED: The goods came back to us. We will write to you.

event.LABEL_CREATED: Label ready, waiting for the carrier
event.EXCEPTION: Delayed or held by the carrier

fact.expectedUnknown: The carrier has not said yet

where.title: Where it is
where.sub: The latest news of your shipment, in your language.

parcels.name: Parcel {seq} of {count}
parcels.carrierOf: Track parcel {seq} on the carrier's site (opens a new tab)

events.title: Carrier events
events.sub: What the carrier reported, in your language.

none.packed: No carrier scans yet: it waits for the carrier.
none.packedEta: No carrier scans yet: it waits for the carrier. Expected delivery: {date}.
none.left: No carrier scans yet. They show here as soon as the carrier sends them.
none.SENDER: This shipment travels with our own van: there are no carrier scans.
none.RECIPIENT: You collect this shipment from us: there are no carrier scans.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.only: Only the town and postcode are shown here, never the full address.

papers.title: Papers
papers.sub: The packing list and the declarations of this shipment. No prices.
papers.search: The papers come with the link in our e-mail: open it to download them.
papers.none: No papers for this shipment yet.
papers.failed: The download did not finish. Try again.

claim.title: Something wrong?
claim.sub: Damaged, missing or not what you ordered: tell us from here.
claim.button: Report a problem with this delivery
claim.opened: The form opened in a new tab.
claim.failed: The form did not open. Check the connection and try again.
claim.tooMany: Forms for this shipment were opened already: use the one you opened, or write to us.

held.SEARCH: To report a problem, open the link in our e-mail, or write to us.
held.NOT_LEFT: It has not left us yet: write to us to change it.
held.RETURNED: The goods came back to us: we will write to you.

search.title: Track an order
search.sub: No link at hand? Type your order reference and the delivery postcode.
search.referenceHint: As on your order or our confirmation.
search.postcodeHint: The postcode of the address it goes to.
search.several_one: This order left in {count} shipment. Choose it:
search.several_other: This order left in {count} shipments. Choose one:
search.checking: A quick check of this browser, then we search…
search.error: The search did not reach us. Check the connection and try again.
search.wait_one: Too many searches: wait {count} minute, then try again.
search.wait_other: Too many searches: wait {count} minutes, then try again.

miss.title: No shipment found for these details.
miss.body: Check the order reference and the postcode of the delivery address. An order shows here once it has been packed.

ended.title: This shipment can no longer be followed here
ended.body: Search again, or write to us.

missing.title: This address is missing whose order it is
missing.body: Open the tracking link from our e-mail, or ask us for it.

reference.long: An order reference has at most 60 characters.
reference.format: Type the reference as on your order.

postcode.long: Type the postcode as it is on the delivery address.
postcode.format: Type the postcode as it is on the delivery address: letters and digits.
